takeaways.en: This module introduces logistic regression, a model used to predict the probability of an outcome, unlike linear regression which predicts continuous numerical values.
Logistic regression utilizes the sigmoid function to calculate probability and employs log loss as its loss function.
Regularization is crucial when training logistic regression models to prevent overfitting and improve generalization.
The module covers the comparison between linear and logistic regression and explores use cases for logistic regression.
Familiarity with introductory machine learning and linear regression concepts is assumed for this 35-minute module.

html.en:
Learning Objectives
  • Identify use cases for performing logistic regression.
  • Explain how logistic regression models use the sigmoid function to calculate probability.
  • Compare linear regression and logistic regression.
  • Explain why logistic regression uses log loss instead of squared loss.
  • Explain the importance of regularization when training logistic regression models.
html.zh:
学习目标
  • 确定执行逻辑回归的用例。
  • 说明逻辑回归模型如何使用 S 型函数计算概率。
  • 比较线性回归和逻辑回归。
  • 说明逻辑回归为何使用对数损失函数，而不是平方损失函数。
  • 说明正则化在训练逻辑回归模型时的重要性。

html.en: In the Linear regression module, you explored how to construct a model to make continuous numerical predictions, such as the fuel efficiency of a car. But what if you want to build a model to answer questions like "Will it rain today?" or "Is this email spam?"
html.zh: 在“线性回归”模块中，您探索了如何构建模型来进行连续的数值预测，例如汽车的燃油效率。但是，如果您想构建一个模型来回答“今天会下雨吗？”或“这封电子邮件是垃圾邮件吗？”这类问题，该怎么办？

html.en: This module introduces a new type of regression model called that is designed to predict the probability of a given outcome.
html.zh: 本单元介绍了一种名为的新类型回归模型，该模型旨在预测给定结果的概率。

heading.en: Logistic regression: Calculating a probability with the sigmoid function
heading.zh: 逻辑回归：使用 S 型函数计算概率

takeaways.en: Logistic regression models output probabilities, which can be used directly or converted to binary categories.
The sigmoid function ensures the output of logistic regression is always between 0 and 1, representing a probability.
A logistic regression model uses a linear equation and the sigmoid function to calculate the probability of an event.
The log-odds (z) represent the log of the ratio of probabilities for the two possible outcomes.

html.en: Many problems require a probability estimate as output. is an extremely efficient mechanism for calculating probabilities. Practically speaking, you can use the returned probability in either of the following two ways:
html.zh: 许多问题都需要将概率估计值作为输出。 是一种用于计算概率的极其高效的机制。实际上，您可以通过以下两种方式之一使用返回的概率：

items.en: Applied "as is." For example, if a spam-prediction model takes an email as input and outputs a value of 0.932, this implies a 93.2% probability that the email is spam.
items.zh: 按原样应用。例如，如果某个垃圾邮件预测模型将电子邮件作为输入，并输出值 0.932，则表示该电子邮件是垃圾邮件的概率为 93.2%。

items.en: Converted to a such as True or False, Spam or Not Spam.
items.zh: 转换为，例如 True 或 False、Spam 或 Not Spam。

html.zh: 本模块重点介绍如何直接使用逻辑回归模型输出。在分类模块中，您将学习如何将此输出转换为二元类别。

html.en: Sigmoid function
html.zh: S 型函数

html.en: You might be wondering how a logistic regression model can ensure its output represents a probability, always outputting a value between 0 and 1. As it happens, there's a family of functions called logistic functions whose output has those same characteristics. The standard logistic function, also known as the (sigmoid means "s-shaped"), has the formula:
html.zh: 您可能想知道，逻辑回归模型如何确保其输出表示概率，始终输出介于 0 到 1 之间的值。实际上，有一系列函数（称为逻辑函数）的输出具有相同的特征。标准逻辑函数（也称为 ，sigmoid 的意思是“S 形”）的公式如下：

html.en: f(x)=1+e−x1​
html.zh: f(x)=1+e−x1​

html.en: where:
html.zh: 其中：

items.en: f(x) is the output of the sigmoid function.
items.zh: f(x) 是 sigmoid 函数的输出。

items.en: e is Euler's number: a mathematical constant ≈ 2.71828.
items.zh: e 是欧拉数：一个数学常数，约为 2.71828。

items.en: x is the input to the sigmoid function.
items.zh: x 是 S 型函数的输入。

html.en: Figure 1 shows the corresponding graph of the sigmoid function.
html.zh: 图 1 显示了 sigmoid 函数的相应图表。

alt.en:
Sigmoid (s-shaped) curve plotted on the Cartesian coordinate plane,
         centered at the origin.
alt.zh: 绘制在笛卡尔坐标平面上、以原点为中心的 S 形曲线。

caption.en: Figure 1. Graph of the sigmoid function. The curve approaches 0 as x values decrease to negative infinity, and 1 as x values increase toward infinity.
caption.zh: 图 1. S 型函数的图。当 x 值减小到负无穷大时，曲线接近 0；当 x 值增大到正无穷大时，曲线接近 1。

html.en: As the input, x, increases, the output of the sigmoid function approaches but never reaches 1. Similarly, as the input decreases, the sigmoid function's output approaches but never reaches 0.
html.zh: 随着输入 x 的增加，sigmoid 函数的输出会接近 1，但永远不会达到 1。同样，随着输入减小，sigmoid 函数的输出会接近但永远不会达到 0。

html.en: The table below shows the output values of the sigmoid function for input values in the range –7 to 7. Note how quickly the sigmoid approaches 0 for decreasing negative input values, and how quickly the sigmoid approaches 1 for increasing positive input values.
html.zh: 下表显示了输入值在 -7 到 7 范围内的 S 型函数输出值。请注意，对于递减的负输入值，S 型函数值会快速接近 0；对于递增的正输入值，S 型函数值会快速接近 1。

html.en: However, no matter how large or how small the input value, the output will always be greater than 0 and less than 1.
html.zh: 不过，无论输入值有多大或多小，输出值始终大于 0 且小于 1。

html.en: Transforming linear output using the sigmoid function
html.zh: 使用 sigmoid 函数转换线性输出

html.en: The following equation represents the linear component of a logistic regression model:
html.zh: 以下等式表示的是逻辑回归模型的线性组成部分：

html.en: z=b+w1​x1​+w2​x2​+…+wN​xN​
html.zh: z=b+w1​x1​+w2​x2​+…+wN​xN​

html.en: where:
html.zh: 其中：

items.en: z is the output of the linear equation, also called the .
items.zh: z 是线性方程的输出，也称为。

items.en: b is the bias.
items.zh: b 是偏差。

items.en: The w values are the model's learned weights.
items.zh: w 的值是该模型学习的权重。

items.en: The x values are the feature values for a particular example.
items.zh: x 的值是特定样本的特征值。x

html.en: To obtain the logistic regression prediction, the z value is then passed to the sigmoid function, yielding a value (a probability) between 0 and 1:
html.zh: 为了获得逻辑回归预测结果，接下来将 z 值传递给 sigmoid 函数，从而得到一个介于 0 和 1 之间的值（概率）：

html.en: y′=1+e−z1​
html.zh: y′=1+e−z1​

html.en: where:
html.zh: 其中：

items.en: y' is the output of the logistic regression model.
items.zh: y' 是逻辑回归模型的输出。

items.en: e is Euler's number: a mathematical constant ≈ 2.71828.
items.zh: e 是欧拉数：一个数学常数，约为 2.71828。

items.en: z is the linear output (as calculated in the preceding equation).
items.zh: z 是线性输出（如上一个等式中计算的那样）。

title.en: Click here to learn more about log-odds
title.zh: 点击此处详细了解对数几率

html.en: In the equation z=b+w1​x1​+w2​x2​+…+wN​xN​, z is referred to as the log-odds because if you start with the following sigmoid function (where y is the output of a logistic regression model, representing a probability):
html.zh: 在等式 z=b+w1​x1​+w2​x2​+…+wN​xN​ 中，z 被称为对数几率，因为如果您从以下 S 型函数（其中 y 是逻辑回归模型的输出，表示概率）开始：

html.en: y=1+e−z1​
html.zh: y=1+e−z1​

html.en: And then solve for z:
html.zh: 然后求解 z：

html.en: z=ln(1−yy​)
html.zh: z=ln(1−yy​)

html.en: Then z is defined as the natural logarithm of the ratio of the probabilities of the two possible outcomes: y and 1 – y.
html.zh: 然后，z 定义为两种可能结果（y 和 1 – y）的概率之比的自然对数。

html.en: Figure 2 illustrates how linear output is transformed to logistic regression output using these calculations.
html.zh: 图 2 说明了如何使用这些计算将线性输出转换为逻辑回归输出。

alt.en:
Left: Line with the points (-7.5, –10), (-2.5, 0), and (0, 5)
         highlighted. Right: Sigmoid curve with the corresponding transformed
         points (-10, 0.00004), (0, 0.5), and (5, 0.9933) highlighted.

caption.en: Figure 2. Left: graph of the linear function z = 2x + 5, with three points highlighted. Right: Sigmoid curve with the same three points highlighted after being transformed by the sigmoid function.
caption.zh: 图 2. 左图：线性函数 z = 2x + 5 的图，其中突出显示了三个点。右图：经过 sigmoid 函数转换后，突出显示了相同的三个点的 sigmoid 曲线。

html.en: In Figure 2, a linear equation becomes input to the sigmoid function, which bends the straight line into an s-shape. Notice that the linear equation can output very big or very small values of z, but the output of the sigmoid function, y', is always between 0 and 1, exclusive. For example, the yellow square on the left graph has a z value of –10, but the sigmoid function in the right graph maps that –10 into a y' value of 0.00004.
html.zh: 在图 2 中，线性方程成为 S 型函数的输入，该函数将直线弯曲成 S 形。请注意，线性方程可以输出非常大或非常小的 z 值，但 sigmoid 函数的输出 y' 始终介于 0 和 1 之间（不含 0 和 1）。例如，左侧图表中的黄色正方形的 z 值为 -10，但右侧图表中的 S 型函数将该 -10 映射为 y' 值 0.00004。

html.en: Exercise: Check your understanding
html.zh: 练习：检查您的理解情况

html.en: A logistic regression model with three features has the following bias and weights:
html.zh: 一个具有三个特征的逻辑回归模型具有以下偏差和权重：

html.en: bw1​w2​w3​​=1=2=−1=5​​
html.zh: bw1​w2​w3​​=1=2=−1=5​​

html.en: Given the following input values:
html.zh: 假设有以下输入值：

html.en: x1​x2​x3​​=0=10=2​​
html.zh: x1​x2​x3​​=0=10=2​​

html.en: Answer the following two questions.
html.zh: 请回答以下两个问题。

q.en: What is the value of z for these input values?
q.zh: 对于这些输入值，z 的值是多少？

why.en: Correct! The linear equation defined by the weights and bias is z = 1 + 2x1 – x2 + 5 x3. Plugging the input values into the equation produces z = 1 + (2)(0) - (10) + (5)(2) = 1
why.zh: 正确！由权重和偏差定义的线性方程为 z = 1 + 2x1 – x2 + 5 x3。将输入值代入方程式，得出 z = 1 + (2)(0) - (10) + (5)(2) = 1

q.en: What is the logistic regression prediction for these input values?
q.zh: 这些输入值的逻辑回归预测结果是什么？

why.en:
As calculated in #1 above, the log-odds for the input values is 1. Plugging that value for z into the sigmoid function:
y=1+e−z1​=1+e−11​=1+0.3671​=1.3671​=0.731
why.zh:
如上文第 1 步中所计算，输入值的对数几率为 1。 将 z 的该值代入 S 型函数：
y=1+e−z1​=1+e−11​=1+0.3671​=1.3671​=0.731

why.en: Remember, the output of the sigmoid function will always be greater than 0 and less than 1.
why.zh: 请注意，sigmoid 函数的输出始终大于 0 且小于 1。

heading.zh: 逻辑回归：损失和正则化

takeaways.en: Logistic regression models are trained similarly to linear regression models but use Log Loss instead of squared loss and require regularization.
Log Loss is used in logistic regression because the rate of change isn't constant, requiring varying precision levels unlike squared loss used in linear regression.
Regularization, such as L2 regularization or early stopping, is crucial in logistic regression to prevent overfitting due to the model's asymptotic nature.

html.en: models are trained using the same process as linear regression models, with two key distinctions:
html.zh: 模型的训练过程与线性回归模型相同，但有两点主要区别：

items.en: Logistic regression models use as the loss function instead of .
items.zh: 逻辑回归模型使用作为损失函数，而不是。

items.en: Applying regularization is critical to prevent .
items.zh: 应用正则化对于防止出现至关重要。

html.en: The following sections discuss these two considerations in more depth.
html.zh: 以下部分将更深入地讨论这两个考虑因素。

html.en: Log Loss
html.zh: 对数损失函数

html.en: In the Linear regression module, you used (also called L2 loss) as the . Squared loss works well for a linear model where the rate of change of the output values is constant. For example, given the linear model y′=b+3x1​, each time you increment the input value x1​ by 1, the output value y′ increases by 3.
html.zh: 在线性回归模块中，您使用了（也称为 L2 损失）作为。对于输出值的变化率恒定的线性模型，平方损失函数效果良好。例如，对于线性模型 y′=b+3x1​，每次将输入值 x1​ 增加 1 时，输出值 y′ 就会增加 3。

html.en: However, the rate of change of a logistic regression model is not constant. As you saw in Calculating a probability, the curve is s-shaped rather than linear. When the log-odds (z) value is closer to 0, small increases in z result in much larger changes to y than when z is a large positive or negative number. The following table shows the sigmoid function's output for input values from 5 to 10, as well as the corresponding precision required to capture the differences in the results.
html.zh: 不过，逻辑回归模型的变化率不是恒定不变的。正如您在计算概率中所看到的， 曲线呈 S 形，而不是线性。当对数几率 (z) 值接近 0 时，z 的小幅增加会导致 y 的变化远大于 z 为较大的正数或负数时的变化。下表显示了输入值为 5 到 10 时 S 型函数的输出，以及捕获结果差异所需的相应精度。

html.en: If you used squared loss to calculate errors for the sigmoid function, as the output got closer and closer to 0 and 1, you would need more memory to preserve the precision needed to track these values.
html.zh: 如果您使用平方损失函数来计算 S 型函数的误差，那么随着输出越来越接近 0 和 1，您需要更多内存来保持跟踪这些值所需的精度。

html.en: Instead, the loss function for logistic regression is . The Log Loss equation returns the logarithm of the magnitude of the change, rather than just the distance from data to prediction. Log Loss is calculated as follows:
html.zh: 相反，逻辑回归的损失函数是。对数损失函数返回的是变化幅度的对数，而不仅仅是数据与预测之间的距离。对数损失的计算方式如下：

html.en: Log Loss=−N1​∑i=1N​[yi​log(yi′​)+(1−yi​)log(1−yi′​)]
html.zh: 对数损失=−N1​∑i=1N​[yi​log(yi′​)+(1−yi​)log(1−yi′​)]

html.en: 其中：
html.zh: 其中：

items.en: N 是数据集中的已标记示例数量
items.zh: N 是数据集中的已标记示例数量

items.en: i 是数据集中示例的索引（例如， (x3​,y3​)是数据集中的第三个示例）
items.zh: i 是数据集中示例的索引（例如， (x3​,y3​)是数据集中的第三个示例）

items.en: yi​ 是第 i个示例的标签。由于这是逻辑回归，因此 yi​ 必须是 0 或 1。
items.zh: yi​ 是第 i个示例的标签。由于这是逻辑回归，因此 yi​ 必须是 0 或 1。

items.en: yi′​ 是模型针对第 i个示例的预测值（介于 0 和 1 之间），由 xi​中的特征集得出。
items.zh: yi′​ 是模型针对第 i个示例的预测值（介于 0 和 1 之间），由 xi​中的特征集得出。

html.en: 此形式的对数损失函数用于计算数据集中所有点的平均对数损失。在实践中，使用平均对数损失函数（而非总对数损失函数）是可取的，因为这样可以分离批次大小和学习速率的调整。
html.zh: 此形式的对数损失函数用于计算数据集中所有点的平均对数损失。在实践中，使用平均对数损失函数（而非总对数损失函数）是可取的，因为这样可以分离批次大小和学习速率的调整。

html.en: 逻辑回归中的正则化
html.zh: 逻辑回归中的正则化

html.en: 是一种在训练期间惩罚模型复杂性的机制，在逻辑回归建模中非常重要。如果不进行正则化，在模型具有大量特征的情况下，逻辑回归的渐近性质会使损失不断趋近于 0。因此，大多数逻辑回归模型都采用以下两种策略之一来降低模型复杂性：
html.zh: 是一种在训练期间惩罚模型复杂性的机制，在逻辑回归建模中非常重要。如果不进行正则化，在模型具有大量特征的情况下，逻辑回归的渐近性质会使损失不断趋近于 0。因此，大多数逻辑回归模型都采用以下两种策略之一来降低模型复杂性：

items.en: 早停法： 限制训练步数，以便在损失仍在减少时停止训练。
items.zh: 早停法： 限制训练步数，以便在损失仍在减少时停止训练。
